name: University of Reading - Malaysia

programmes.name: Law (LL.B)
programmes.about: A three-year LL.B. with the same degree and curriculum as Reading in the UK, recognised for the Malaysian CLP and UK Bar and solicitor routes.
programmes.overview: Year 1 covers the English legal system, contract, criminal law, tort and public law. Year 2 adds equity, land law and electives, including Malaysian Legal System. Year 3 combines EU law with elective modules and an optional dissertation. The page says students can spend one or two years at the Reading UK campus.
programmes.ib: Overall 30 points. No subject or level minimum is published on the programme page.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers are based on grades; English at IELTS 6.5 (5.5 in each part) for undergraduates.

flagshipSource.title: LL.B at UoRM: three years, accreditation and structure

programmes.name: Business and Management
programmes.about: A three-year Henley Business School degree with an entrepreneurial focus, taught on the Malaysia campus.
programmes.overview: Year 1 starts with business foundations such as Management Debates. Later years add social responsibility and electives, with entrepreneurial project work. The programme page lists three years and credit in Mathematics at SPM, IGCSE or equivalent.
programmes.ib: Overall 30 points; a 3 in SL Mathematics is expected.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade-based; credit in Mathematics at SPM/IGCSE level or equivalent is expected.

flagshipSource.title: BSc Business and Management at Henley Business School Malaysia

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: A three-year psychology degree accredited by the British Psychological Society, with applied projects and work placements.
programmes.overview: Year 1 covers foundations and learning; Year 2 adds core depth including professional and clinical practice with a work placement; Year 3 offers specialist modules and a project. The page states British Psychological Society accreditation.
programmes.ib: Overall 30 points; a 3 in SL Mathematics and one SL science subject are expected.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade-based; credits in Mathematics and Science at SPM/IGCSE level or equivalent are expected.

flagshipSource.title: BSc Psychology: BPS accreditation, placements and structure

summary: UK-owned branch campus at EduCity, Iskandar Puteri, awarding Reading honours degrees in business, law, psychology and built environment.

ib.text: IB Diploma: 30 points overall for the three degrees checked; Business also expects SL Maths 3, Psychology SL Maths 3 plus an SL science. Course Results alone are not addressed. Confirm with UoRM.

languageOfInstruction.note: Programme pages and the English-proficiency table (undergraduate IELTS 6.5) show English-medium Reading degrees; MPU general studies modules may use Malay.

notes: No 2027 application or closing dates are published: the intakes page says dates for 2026/27 and 2027/28 are being finalised and lists undergraduate intakes in April and September. No date is recorded here; check with admissions.

IB Diploma: the three programme pages checked give 30 points overall. Entry tables for the other nine undergraduate degrees were not read. No IB Course Results route and no per-subject grade minimums are stated.

English: undergraduates need IELTS Academic 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each component, or an equivalent test listed in the September 2026 table. The table does not say whether IB English exempts you; ask.

Fees: the fee table lists RM 48,000 a year for international and RM 40,800 for Malaysian students on these degrees, subject to 6% SST for international students. The page gives no year; 2027 fees are unconfirmed.
International applicants pay an application fee of RM 530 (including 6% SST), deducted from tuition on enrolment. Forecast results can receive a conditional offer.
Only three of twelve undergraduate degrees are detailed here; the intakes page lists the rest with their MQA approvals.
